title: The buyer “accidentally overpaid”
scenario: You sell a desk in a student marketplace. The buyer sends a screenshot showing they paid $250 instead of $50 and asks you to return $200 to a different payment handle immediately.

answers.A: Tell the buyer to cancel/reverse the original transaction through the payment service.
answers.B: Refund once the screenshot shows “Completed,” because keeping the money would be wrong.
answers.C: Check your actual payment account and do not send a separate refund unless the original payment is genuinely settled and reversible through the provider.

explanation: Screenshots can be forged and incoming payments may later reverse. Your account ledger is stronger evidence than the buyer’s image.
